graph_discipline: Roots are nodes; branches remain edge or port labels.

root_resolution.note: The basmala is included in the analysis frame. It strengthens mercy, blessing, divine favor, hospitality, and afterlife-reward activations but introduces no additional branch inventory roots.

surface_mechanism: 88:7 closes the deprivation scene: the food neither fattens nor avails against hunger.
88:8-10 reverses the scene through contented faces, satisfaction with effort, and a high garden.
88:11-12 defines the garden by the absence of vain speech and the presence of a flowing spring.
88:13-14 completes the ordered hospitality scene with raised couches and cups set in place.
